prompt: A slow lateral dolly right with the brick arches passing in the foreground. The last carriages go dark, and through the gaps two distant explosions appear, an orange fireball and then a rising smoke column, while a cyan arc pulse flickers in the cloud. Shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so anything moving fast smears with natural motion blur. One continuous shot, no cuts.
why: Kai 9 Nov mood board r2: 'let's just cut videos of all of these' (scale round)
